from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import cv2
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

CASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SRC = np.array(Image.open(CASE / 'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
H, W = SRC.shape[:2]


def grab_object(poly, dark_limit=92):
    """Segment one of the nearly-black robot assemblies from a tight polygon."""
    bgr = cv2.cvtColor(SRC, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
    m = np.zeros((H,W), np.uint8)
    cv2.fillPoly(m, [np.asarray(poly, np.int32)], cv2.GC_PR_FGD)
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(bgr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    m[(gray < dark_limit) & (m == cv2.GC_PR_FGD)] = cv2.GC_FGD
    m[m == 0] = cv2.GC_BGD
    bgd = np.zeros((1,65), np.float64); fgd = np.zeros((1,65), np.float64)
    cv2.grabCut(bgr, m, None, bgd, fgd, 5, cv2.GC_INIT_WITH_MASK)
    mask = np.where((m==cv2.GC_FGD)|(m==cv2.GC_PR_FGD), 255, 0).astype(np.uint8)
    mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
    return mask

LEFT_POLY = [(0,33),(25,37),(48,44),(79,35),(116,34),(125,45),(123,59),
             (96,64),(126,64),(128,84),(95,97),(63,92),(43,99),(0,93)]
RIGHT_POLY = [(256,44),(239,49),(222,46),(199,43),(177,44),(170,56),(190,62),
              (170,60),(168,76),(194,86),(224,90),(256,108)]
left_m = grab_object(LEFT_POLY)
right_m = grab_object(RIGHT_POLY)
all_m = cv2.dilate(cv2.max(left_m, right_m), np.ones((7,7),np.uint8), iterations=1)
# A clean plate behind both robot hands. Telea only estimates pixels that are initially occluded.
clean = cv2.cvtColor(cv2.inpaint(cv2.cvtColor(SRC,cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR), all_m, 5, cv2.INPAINT_TELEA),cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
# A clean source texture for the silver door.
door_src = clean.copy()

# Closed refrigerator-face quadrilateral and hinge (left) edge.
Q0 = np.float32([[91,0],[220,0],[158,191],[102,191]])
QF = np.float32([[91,0],[145,2],[131,191],[102,191]])


def alpha_paste(dst, rgba, x=0, y=0):
    """Pastes an RGB object with an 8-bit alpha mask into an RGB ndarray."""
    rgb, a = rgba
    h,w = a.shape
    x0=max(0,x); y0=max(0,y); x1=min(W,x+w); y1=min(H,y+h)
    if x1<=x0 or y1<=y0: return
    sx=x0-x; sy=y0-y
    aa=a[sy:sy+y1-y0,sx:sx+x1-x0].astype(np.float32)[...,None]/255.
    dst[y0:y1,x0:x1] = np.clip(rgb[sy:sy+y1-y0,sx:sx+x1-x0]*aa + dst[y0:y1,x0:x1]*(1-aa),0,255).astype(np.uint8)


def perspective_x_at_y(q, y, edge=1):
    # edge 1 is the free (right) edge between q[1] and q[2].
    a,b=q[edge],q[edge+1]
    t=np.clip((y-a[1])/(b[1]-a[1]+1e-6),0,1)
    return float(a[0]*(1-t)+b[0]*t)


def make_interior():
    """A subdued, perspectively drawn refrigerator cavity behind the door."""
    im = Image.fromarray(clean.copy())
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im, 'RGBA')
    op=[tuple(v) for v in Q0.astype(int)]
    d.polygon(op, fill=(18,24,27,255))
    # Inner liner has a cool metallic cast and converging side walls.
    d.polygon([(97,5),(211,5),(157,186),(105,186)], fill=(41,49,52,255))
    d.polygon([(97,5),(109,12),(112,180),(105,186)], fill=(104,111,109,255))
    d.polygon([(211,5),(202,13),(151,179),(157,186)], fill=(15,19,21,255))
    d.rectangle((109,10,201,27), fill=(21,27,29,255))
    # Perspective shelves.
    for y in (52,95,138):
        lx=int(109 + (y/186)*3); rx=int(202-(y/186)*49)
        d.polygon([(lx,y),(rx,y-1),(rx-1,y+4),(lx,y+5)], fill=(167,181,180,180))
        d.line([(lx,y),(rx,y-1)], fill=(224,235,231,190), width=1)
    # A few restrained, realistic contents, all behind the shelves.
    d.rounded_rectangle((121,30,134,51),3,fill=(226,231,218,255),outline=(164,171,164,255))
    d.rectangle((124,28,131,31),fill=(65,117,156,255))
    d.ellipse((162,31,178,50),fill=(166,48,42,255)); d.ellipse((171,36,185,51),fill=(201,117,35,255))
    d.rounded_rectangle((118,70,135,94),2,fill=(225,221,183,255),outline=(139,139,123,255))
    d.rectangle((121,67,132,71),fill=(59,123,76,255))
    d.ellipse((153,77,169,94),fill=(83,139,62,255)); d.ellipse((164,80,178,94),fill=(183,73,49,255))
    d.rounded_rectangle((119,112,140,138),3,fill=(188,211,220,255),outline=(110,131,138,255))
    d.rectangle((123,108,136,113),fill=(53,101,141,255))
    # cool, soft interior light at the top
    glow=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(0,0,0,0)); gd=ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
    gd.ellipse((105,-24,205,72),fill=(210,235,228,46))
    glow=glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(15)); im=Image.alpha_composite(im.convert('RGBA'),glow).convert('RGB')
    return np.array(im)

INTERIOR = make_interior()


def smooth(t):
    t=np.clip(t,0.,1.); return t*t*(3-2*t)


def frame_at(i):
    if i == 0:
        return SRC.copy()
    # Hold long enough to read the initial grasp, then open in one steady controlled motion.
    p=smooth((i-2)/17.0)
    if p < 1e-5:
        base=clean.copy()
    else:
        base=INTERIOR.copy()
    q=Q0*(1-p)+QF*p
    # Shadow cast by the moving slab into the refrigerator cavity.
    if p>0:
        shadow=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
        free=np.array([q[1],q[2]],np.int32)
        cv2.line(shadow,tuple(free[0]),tuple(free[1]),160,10)
        shadow=cv2.GaussianBlur(shadow,(0,0),4)
        base=(base.astype(np.float32)*(1-shadow[...,None].astype(np.float32)/620.)).astype(np.uint8)
    # Rigid projective motion of the complete door plane.
    M=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(Q0,q.astype(np.float32))
    warped=cv2.warpPerspective(door_src,M,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
    qmask=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillConvexPoly(qmask,np.round(q).astype(np.int32),255)
    qmask=cv2.GaussianBlur(qmask,(3,3),0.45)
    a=qmask.astype(np.float32)[...,None]/255.
    base=np.clip(warped*a+base*(1-a),0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    # Dark door gasket and silver thickness on its free edge make the rotation legible.
    a1=tuple(np.round(q[1]).astype(int)); a2=tuple(np.round(q[2]).astype(int))
    cv2.line(base,a1,a2,(24,28,28),5,cv2.LINE_AA)
    cv2.line(base,(a1[0]-2,a1[1]),(a2[0]-2,a2[1]),(125,128,124),2,cv2.LINE_AA)
    # The left robot remains fixed and rigid in the workspace.
    lm=cv2.GaussianBlur(left_m,(3,3),0.45)
    alpha_paste(base,(SRC,lm),0,0)
    # Right arm: wrist/gripper translates rigidly with the free edge. A rear link extends
    # from it to the off-camera joint, preserving a plausible connected mechanism.
    edge0=perspective_x_at_y(Q0,70); edge=perspective_x_at_y(q,70)
    dx=int(round(edge-edge0)); dy=int(round(3*p))
    # rear cylindrical link, placed behind the hand
    layer=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(0,0,0,0)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer,'RGBA')
    d.polygon([(211+dx,66+dy),(223+dx,94+dy),(256,113),(256,66)],fill=(20,23,22,255))
    d.line([(217+dx,72+dy),(255,82)],fill=(73,76,72,190),width=3)
    layer=layer.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(0.35))
    la=np.array(layer); alpha_paste(base,(la[:,:,:3],la[:,:,3]),0,0)
    # translate only, no scaling or bending: the gripper is mechanically rigid
    T=np.float32([[1,0,dx],[0,1,dy]])
    rob=cv2.warpAffine(SRC,T,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=0)
    rm=cv2.warpAffine(right_m,T,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=0)
    rm=cv2.GaussianBlur(rm,(3,3),0.4)
    alpha_paste(base,(rob,rm),0,0)
    # tiny contact shadow where jaws clasp the moving door edge
    cy=64+dy; cx=int(round(perspective_x_at_y(q,cy)))
    cv2.ellipse(base,(cx,cy),(3,9),0,0,360,(18,20,20),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
    return base

frames=np.stack([frame_at(i) for i in range(20)]).astype(np.uint8)
frames[0]=SRC # contract: exactly pixel-identical
artifact_io.save(frames, CASE)

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

INTERIOR = make_interior()


def smooth(t):
    t=np.clip(t,0.,1.); return t*t*(3-2*t)


def frame_at(i):
    if i == 0:
        return SRC.copy()
    # Hold long enough to read the initial grasp, then open in one steady controlled motion.
    p=smooth((i-2)/17.0)
    if p < 1e-5:
        base=clean.copy()
    else:
        base=INTERIOR.copy()
    q=Q0*(1-p)+QF*p
    # Shadow cast by the moving slab into the refrigerator cavity.
    if p>0:
        shadow=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
        free=np.array([q[1],q[2]],np.int32)
        cv2.line(shadow,tuple(free[0]),tuple(free[1]),160,10)
        shadow=cv2.GaussianBlur(shadow,(0,0),4)
        base=(base.astype(np.float32)*(1-shadow[...,None].astype(np.float32)/620.)).astype(np.uint8)
    # Rigid projective motion of the complete door plane.
    M=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(Q0,q.astype(np.float32))
    warped=cv2.warpPerspective(door_src,M,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
    qmask=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillConvexPoly(qmask,np.round(q).astype(np.int32),255)
    qmask=cv2.GaussianBlur(qmask,(3,3),0.45)
    a=qmask.astype(np.float32)[...,None]/255.
    base=np.clip(warped*a+base*(1-a),0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    # Dark door gasket and silver thickness on its free edge make the rotation legible.
    a1=tuple(np.round(q[1]).astype(int)); a2=tuple(np.round(q[2]).astype(int))
    cv2.line(base,a1,a2,(24,28,28),5,cv2.LINE_AA)
    cv2.line(base,(a1[0]-2,a1[1]),(a2[0]-2,a2[1]),(125,128,124),2,cv2.LINE_AA)
    # The left robot remains fixed and rigid in the workspace.
    lm=cv2.GaussianBlur(left_m,(3,3),0.45)
    alpha_paste(base,(SRC,lm),0,0)
    # Right arm: wrist/gripper translates rigidly with the free edge. A rear link extends
    # from it to the off-camera joint, preserving a plausible connected mechanism.
    edge0=perspective_x_at_y(Q0,70); edge=perspective_x_at_y(q,70)
    dx=int(round(edge-edge0)); dy=int(round(3*p))
    # rear cylindrical link, placed behind the hand
    layer=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(0,0,0,0)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer,'RGBA')
    d.polygon([(211+dx,66+dy),(223+dx,94+dy),(256,113),(256,66)],fill=(20,23,22,255))
    d.line([(217+dx,72+dy),(255,82)],fill=(73,76,72,190),width=3)
    layer=layer.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(0.35))
    la=np.array(layer); alpha_paste(base,(la[:,:,:3],la[:,:,3]),0,0)
    # translate only, no scaling or bending: the gripper is mechanically rigid
    T=np.float32([[1,0,dx],[0,1,dy]])
    rob=cv2.warpAffine(SRC,T,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=0)
    rm=cv2.warpAffine(right_m,T,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,borderValue=0)
    rm=cv2.GaussianBlur(rm,(3,3),0.4)
    alpha_paste(base,(rob,rm),0,0)
    # tiny contact shadow where jaws clasp the moving door edge
    cy=64+dy; cx=int(round(perspective_x_at_y(q,cy)))
    cv2.ellipse(base,(cx,cy),(3,9),0,0,360,(18,20,20),1,cv2.LINE_AA)
    return base

frames=np.stack([frame_at(i) for i in range(20)]).astype(np.uint8)
frames[0]=SRC # contract: exactly pixel-identical
